candidateDeltaAudit.method: Read-only compare of the two commits in a local best-agent checkout (git log / git diff --name-only / git diff --shortstat / git show) against the argv this benchmark actually uses: headless `best-agent run --model <model> --model-timeout-ms <ms> --attempt-remaining-ms <ms>`, no --compact-dir, no --memory-dir, toolExclude [network], includeInteraction false, execution profile plain/unrestricted/host/path with read+write+exec grants.
candidateDeltaAudit.unchangedPipelinePaths: Absent from the changed-file list: apps/cli/src/v3-run-options.ts (--model-timeout-ms / --attempt-remaining-ms parsing and its >210000 ms floor), apps/cli/src/v3-context-composition.ts, apps/cli/src/index.ts, apps/cli/src/product-slices/thread-orchestration-root.ts, apps/cli/src/v3-thread-tool.ts, apps/cli/src/application-root-neutral.ts, apps/cli/src/product-slices/contracts.ts, v3/src/plan.ts, v3/src/kernel/transition.ts and packages/harness-v3/**. The per-call ceiling, the attempt budget, the tool-call caps, the retry policy and the kernel plan/transition are therefore byte-identical to the candidate that produced run 36669802530's three measured cells.
modelVisibleChanges: subagent-start is now ref best-agent/cli/subagent-start-v3 (package version 6) and accepts an optional `name` of 1 to 4 code points and at most 48 UTF-8 bytes after trimming; its description tells the model to pick a short name from the user's naming theme and to keep identity or role declarations out of `task`.

The exec tool no longer caps each args entry at 4096 UTF-8 bytes in either its JSON schema or its canonicalizer; only `command` keeps the 1..4096-byte bound, the whole-argv aggregate bound of 32768 bytes is unchanged, and the description now states the aggregate bound instead of the per-entry one.

Under the path command policy the exec tool admits any command name without a path separator that is not "." or "..", has no control character and is at most 255 UTF-8 bytes, replacing the previous alias-shaped-name admission, and its command-shape rejection text now says "resolved from the captured PATH, spaces and Unicode allowed".

process-start now accepts either a command name resolved from the captured startup PATH or an absolute executable path under the path command policy, advertises a 32768-byte whole-argv bound, and reports a new `executable-unavailable` failure code when no PATH entry resolves, with no fallback after a failed spawn.

The composition layer's process-start instruction text is now policy-dependent: under the path policy it no longer claims process-start admits only its own alias list and instead states that an installed command name from the captured PATH or an absolute executable is accepted.

The edit tool now requires both a read and a write grant for the target path, and its description says the current file supplies the match so a prior read Tool call is not required; its read-receipt digest and revision preconditions were removed, so stale-observation conflicts no longer arise from edit. Under this benchmark's unrestricted workspace with read+write+exec grants the tool resolves exactly one scope per path, so the admission itself is unchanged here.
The write tool's description now states that replacing an existing file requires a prior read Tool call in this Session.

apply_patch no longer enforces a 16384-byte per-hunk-line bound (constant, description and rejection removed) and now reads each current file when called, passing its complete current content as the write precondition, with its description stating that a prior read Tool call is not required.
A workspace write that hits ENOENT now fails as `not-found` instead of a generic write failure.

A compact fold may now contribute an extra leading block with provenance `compact:<artifactRef>:summary` whose content is a bounded "Task goal:" line plus at most eight verbatim quotes, guarded by a 2048-byte summary bound, a 4096-byte encoded-block reserve and the provider's block budget.

The headless run path now performs one additional provider call per fold (prompt: select up to eight important short exact quotes; maxOutputTokens 768, maxRetries 0, 30-second AbortSignal timeout) whose output is filtered to exact substrings of the source or previous summary before it enters the compact block.

The compact instruction text was rewritten: it now names `compact:<ref>:summary` as a source-checked task report, tells the model the locator file is a small index naming one file per group and to read only the needed group file, and drops the previous per-group line-range reading instruction.

The folded-history export now writes one file per group (folded/<ref>-group-<ordinal>.txt) plus a small index naming those files, replacing the single file whose index listed each group's section line range.

A later fold no longer copies a prior read result of a folded export path into the artifact; such a result is replaced by the literal line "tool: read → known/succeeded: [prior folded export excerpt omitted]".
The compact artifact policy now reserves an additional 4096 bytes for the locator and summary block, so maxGroupBytes and maxArtifactBytes are 4096 bytes smaller than before.

The compact provider now compares its pending-poll and transient-retry delays against a monotonic clock instead of wall-clock time, so a pending basis is actually polled and a transient artifact read is actually retried within the admitted deadline instead of failing immediately.
nonModelVisibleChanges: TUI and dimsdk route ownership work (turn-dispatch joining on route switch, session-scoped compact toasts, goal-edit currency, ask-user comment) is confined to apps/cli/src/dimsdk and its tests.

The auto-compact turn owner's preflight now resolves the host's captured session id and exposes an onDispatch hook, but that owner is only consumed by the TUI store, so the headless path is unaffected.

Sandbox-only surfaces changed without affecting the plain/unrestricted/host profile: the seatbelt host now uses a private temporary HOME and TMPDIR, the sandboxed workspace backend resolves exec commands from the captured PATH, and the external-process-service isolated environment sets HOME and XDG_CONFIG_HOME only when process isolation is workspace-sandbox.

The web_fetch URL capacity increase to 8000 bytes, its MIME admission tightening to application/json, and the matching thread-store codec bound apply only to the network tool package, which this benchmark excludes.

The interaction tool bounds relaxation, the thread-store interaction payload bounds, and the interaction answer bound change from 8192 bytes to the generic user-message bound apply only to the interactive TUI surface, which headless runs do not select.

The execution-profile validation relaxation that admits path command policy with the sandbox/scoped/workspace-sandbox tuple and switches the interactive ask/auto modes to path command policy does not change the explicitly pinned benchmark profile.

docs/ (six product-v3 documents, one capability document, five new proposals), specs/ (seven amended, eight new, plus README) and 35 test files record or verify the above without changing the model-visible contract.
